places.name: FlowbindOpenPurchaseOrders
places.description: Status markers for open Flowbind purchase orders, including an order in transit; one marker is not a stock quantity.

places.name: FlowbindArrivedInQuarantine
places.description: Status markers for arrived Flowbind deliveries awaiting quality release; not counted as usable inventory. Not physical quantities.

places.name: FlowbindPhysicalArrivalEvents
places.description: Externally supplied physical-arrival events, one marker per intended order arrival; their timing and order matching are not yet modelled.

places.name: FlowbindQualityClearanceEvents
places.description: Externally supplied decision that a quarantined Flowbind lot passes supplier/material, quantity, packaging, damage and certificate checks; timing and lot matching not modelled.

places.name: FlowbindQualityRejectionEvents
places.description: Externally supplied decision that a quarantined Flowbind lot fails quality; timing and lot matching not modelled.

places.name: FlowbindReleasedLots
places.description: Status markers for quality-released usable Flowbind lots in SAP; not a physical stock quantity.

places.name: FlowbindRejectedForDisposal
places.description: Status markers for rejected Flowbind lots removed from inventory and sent for disposal at Site 1000 cost; not a physical quantity or cost ledger.

transitions.name: Flowbind arrives and PO closes
transitions.description: Physical arrival closes an open Flowbind PO and moves its delivery into quarantine; pass or fail quality decisions are separate externally signalled paths.

transitions.name: Quality releases Flowbind lot
transitions.description: An externally supplied pass decision moves one quarantined lot status into SAP usable-lot status. No quality duration or success probability is implied.

transitions.name: Quality rejects Flowbind lot
transitions.description: An externally supplied failed-check decision removes quarantined lot status into disposal; no return-to-supplier or refund path is represented.
